status: Applied on 23 October 2026 with explicit approval. Original proposed inputs, preconditions and rollback are retained below; application records returned IDs.

input.name: Desktop / Initial profile origins over time
input.description: Distinct desktop profiles first observed in each project-calendar week, split by the permanent initial profile origin. Existing-profile origin is not a completed upgrade. Fresh profiles can include cleared data; unopened or opted-out installs are absent.

rollback.name: Desktop / Fresh installs vs upgrades over time
rollback.description: Trend of new (fresh) vs upgrading installations over time, broken down by profile_origin.

input.name: Desktop / Active installations in the selected period
input.description: Distinct foreground-active desktop installations across the selected project-calendar period. The default -7d includes partial today and can span eight calendar dates. Use the linked UTC reports for exactly seven completed UTC dates. These are retained profile UUIDs, not people.

rollback.name: Desktop / Rolling 7-day active installations
rollback.description: Unique active installations in the last 7 days.

input.name: Desktop / Observed new profiles since tracking began
input.description: Distinct desktop installation UUIDs with installation_observed and fresh initial origin, since tracking began on 12 October 2026. Retained reinstalls keep identity. Cleared or separate profiles can count again; unopened and opted-out installations are absent. This is not a people or installer-download total.

input.name: Desktop / Observed new profiles in the selected period
input.description: Distinct desktop profiles first observed as fresh during the selected project-calendar period. Existing-profile and unknown origins remain separate in the initial-origin report. Retained reinstalls keep identity; cleared profiles can count again. All build channels are included unless filtered.

input.name: Desktop / Completed UTC activity and partial today
input.description: Foreground-active installation UUIDs: yesterday DAU, the union across the seven completed UTC dates ending yesterday, and partial today DAU. Uses activity_date. Standalone SQL controls select build channel and distribution; source date filter stays all-time. No people, background-use or exact-once claim.

source.query:
WITH toDate(formatDateTime(now(), '%Y-%m-%d', 'UTC')) AS utc_today
SELECT
    toString(addDays(utc_today, -1)) AS completed_utc_day,
    uniqExactIf(distinct_id, toDate(properties.activity_date) = addDays(utc_today, -1)) AS dau_completed_day,
    toString(addDays(utc_today, -7)) AS wau_first_utc_day,
    uniqExactIf(distinct_id, toDate(properties.activity_date) >= addDays(utc_today, -7) AND toDate(properties.activity_date) < utc_today) AS wau_seven_completed_days,
    toString(utc_today) AS partial_utc_day,
    uniqExactIf(distinct_id, toDate(properties.activity_date) = utc_today) AS dau_partial_today
FROM events
WHERE event = 'app_active_day'
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime(concat(toString(addDays(utc_today, -7)), ' 00:00:00'), 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime(concat(toString(addDays(utc_today, 1)), ' 00:00:00'), 'UTC')
  AND properties.os IN ('windows', 'macos', 'linux')
  AND ({variables.desktop_build_channel} = 'all' OR properties.build_channel = {variables.desktop_build_channel})
  AND ({variables.desktop_distribution} = 'all' OR properties.distribution = {variables.desktop_distribution})
  AND {filters}

input.name: Desktop / UTC DAU and rolling WAU
input.description: Daily foreground-active installation UUIDs and the union across each UTC day plus its previous six dates. Last 30 completed days and partial today. First six tracking days have partial history. Standalone SQL controls select build channel/distribution. Do not inherit dashboard date filters.

source.query:
WITH toDate(formatDateTime(now(), '%Y-%m-%d', 'UTC')) AS utc_today
SELECT
    activity_day AS utc_activity_date,
    if(activity_day = utc_today, 'partial today', 'complete') AS period_status,
    if(addDays(activity_day, -6) < toDate('2026-10-12'), 'partial tracking history', 'available tracking history') AS wau_history,
    uniqExactIf(installation_id, active_that_day AND installation_id != '') AS dau,
    uniqExactIf(installation_id, installation_id != '') AS wau
FROM (
    SELECT
        addDays(toDate(properties.activity_date), offset) AS activity_day,
        distinct_id AS installation_id,
        offset = 0 AS active_that_day
    FROM events
    ARRAY JOIN range(7) AS offset
    WHERE event = 'app_active_day'
      AND timestamp >= toDateTime(concat(toString(addDays(utc_today, -36)), ' 00:00:00'), 'UTC')
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(concat(toString(addDays(utc_today, 1)), ' 00:00:00'), 'UTC')
      AND properties.os IN ('windows', 'macos', 'linux')
      AND ({variables.desktop_build_channel} = 'all' OR properties.build_channel = {variables.desktop_build_channel})
      AND ({variables.desktop_distribution} = 'all' OR properties.distribution = {variables.desktop_distribution})
      AND {filters}
    UNION ALL
    SELECT addDays(utc_today, -offset) AS activity_day, '' AS installation_id, false AS active_that_day
    FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(range(31)) AS offset)
)
WHERE activity_day >= addDays(utc_today, -30)
  AND activity_day <= utc_today
  AND activity_day >= toDate('2026-10-12')
GROUP BY activity_day
ORDER BY activity_day
LIMIT 31

input.name: Desktop / First observed arrivals by release
input.description: One first arrival per installation UUID and version across retained history, split into new profile, known upgrade, downgrade, channel transition and unknown history. Original event time determines first arrival. Standalone all-time source; build channel and distribution controls apply after first arrival. Ratios use all arrivals, including unknown history.

source.query:
WITH source AS (
SELECT
    toString(uuid) AS event_uuid,
    distinct_id AS installation_id,
    timestamp AS observed_at,
    toString(properties.app_version) AS app_version,
    toString(properties.build_channel) AS build_channel,
    toString(properties.distribution) AS distribution,
    toString(properties.os) AS os,
    toString(properties.observation_kind) AS observation_kind,
    coalesce(toString(properties.previous_app_version), '') AS previous_app_version,
    coalesce(toString(properties.previous_build_channel), '') AS previous_build_channel
FROM events
WHERE event = 'app_version_observed'
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-12 00:00:00', 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < now() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  AND properties.os IN ('windows', 'macos', 'linux')
  AND {filters}
), deduplicated AS (
    SELECT event_uuid,
        argMin(tuple(installation_id, observed_at, app_version, build_channel, distribution, os,
                     observation_kind, previous_app_version, previous_build_channel), observed_at) AS observation
    FROM source
    GROUP BY event_uuid
), first_arrivals AS (
    SELECT tupleElement(observation, 1) AS installation_id,
        tupleElement(observation, 3) AS app_version,
        argMin(observation, tuple(tupleElement(observation, 2), event_uuid)) AS first_observation
    FROM deduplicated
    GROUP BY installation_id, app_version
), classified AS (
    SELECT installation_id, app_version,
        tupleElement(first_observation, 2) AS first_observed_at,
        tupleElement(first_observation, 4) AS build_channel,
        tupleElement(first_observation, 5) AS distribution,
        tupleElement(first_observation, 6) AS os,
        tupleElement(first_observation, 7) AS observation_kind,
        tupleElement(first_observation, 8) AS previous_app_version,
        tupleElement(first_observation, 9) AS previous_build_channel,
        match(app_version, '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+(-nightly[.][0-9]{8}[.][0-9]+)?$') AS version_known,
        match(previous_app_version, '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+(-nightly[.][0-9]{8}[.][0-9]+)?$') AS previous_version_known,
        tuple(toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '^([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '^[0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)')), if(match(app_version, '-nightly[.]'), 0, 1), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '-nightly[.]([0-9]{8})[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '-nightly[.][0-9]{8}[.]([0-9]+)$'))) AS version_key,
        tuple(toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '^([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '^[0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)')), if(match(previous_app_version, '-nightly[.]'), 0, 1), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '-nightly[.]([0-9]{8})[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '-nightly[.][0-9]{8}[.]([0-9]+)$'))) AS previous_version_key,
        multiIf(
            observation_kind = 'new_profile' AND version_known, 'new profile',
            observation_kind != 'transition' OR NOT version_known OR NOT previous_version_known
                OR build_channel = 'unknown' OR previous_build_channel IN ('', 'unknown'), 'unknown history',
            build_channel != previous_build_channel, 'channel transition',
            version_key > previous_version_key, 'known upgrade',
            version_key < previous_version_key, 'downgrade',
            'unknown history'
        ) AS arrival_category
    FROM first_arrivals
)
SELECT app_version AS release,
    count() AS total_arrivals,
    countIf(arrival_category = 'new profile') AS new_profiles,
    countIf(arrival_category = 'known upgrade') AS known_upgrades,
    countIf(arrival_category = 'downgrade') AS downgrades,
    countIf(arrival_category = 'channel transition') AS channel_transitions,
    countIf(arrival_category = 'unknown history') AS unknown_history,
    countIf(arrival_category = 'known upgrade') / nullIf(count(), 0) AS known_upgrade_share,
    countIf(arrival_category = 'unknown history') / nullIf(count(), 0) AS unknown_share
FROM classified
WHERE ({variables.desktop_build_channel} = 'all' OR build_channel = {variables.desktop_build_channel})
  AND ({variables.desktop_distribution} = 'all' OR distribution = {variables.desktop_distribution})
GROUP BY app_version
ORDER BY max(version_key) DESC
LIMIT 100

input.name: Desktop / Known upgrade installations for a target release
input.description: Up to 100 anonymous installation UUIDs whose first arrival on the target version was an explicit same-build-channel version increase. Target version, build channel and distribution are standalone SQL controls. Ordered by original event time; no named people. Unknown-history and inferred historical changes are excluded.

        tuple(toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '^([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '^[0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)')), if(match(app_version, '-nightly[.]'), 0, 1), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '-nightly[.]([0-9]{8})[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(app_version, '-nightly[.][0-9]{8}[.]([0-9]+)$'))) AS version_key,
        tuple(toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '^([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '^[0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.]([0-9]+)')), if(match(previous_app_version, '-nightly[.]'), 0, 1), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '-nightly[.]([0-9]{8})[.]')), toIntOrZero(extract(previous_app_version, '-nightly[.][0-9]{8}[.]([0-9]+)$'))) AS previous_version_key,
        multiIf(
            observation_kind = 'new_profile' AND version_known, 'new profile',
            observation_kind != 'transition' OR NOT version_known OR NOT previous_version_known
                OR build_channel = 'unknown' OR previous_build_channel IN ('', 'unknown'), 'unknown history',

        ) AS arrival_category
    FROM first_arrivals

SELECT installation_id, app_version, first_observed_at, previous_app_version,
    previous_build_channel, build_channel, distribution, os
FROM classified
WHERE arrival_category = 'known upgrade'
  AND app_version = {variables.desktop_target_version}
  AND ({variables.desktop_build_channel} = 'all' OR build_channel = {variables.desktop_build_channel})
  AND ({variables.desktop_distribution} = 'all' OR distribution = {variables.desktop_distribution})
ORDER BY first_observed_at DESC, installation_id
LIMIT 100
